module.purpose: Defines the QueryClient class, the central imperative manager for query and mutation caches, default options, and connectivity subscriptions in React Query core.
module.summary: This file exports the QueryClient class which owns private QueryCache and MutationCache instances, default options maps, and mount-count-controlled subscriptions to focus and online managers. It provides imperative APIs to fetch, prefetch, ensure, invalidate, refetch, cancel, remove, reset, and read/write query data, plus per-key default option resolution for queries and mutations. It uses notifyManager batching to coalesce cache updates and resolves stale-time/network-mode defaults in a central defaultQueryOptions method.
module.businessContext: Part of TanStack Query core. Enables client-side cached data fetching and synchronization. Failure breaks app data management, caching, and background updates.

unmount(): void {
    this.#mountCount--
    if (this.#mountCount !== 0) return

    this.#unsubscribeFocus?.()
    this.#unsubscribeFocus = undefined

    this.#unsubscribeOnline?.()
    this.#unsubscribeOnline = undefined
  }

units.name: setQueryData
units.source:
setQueryData<
    TQueryFnData = unknown,
    TTaggedQueryKey extends QueryKey = QueryKey,
    TInferredQueryFnData = InferDataFromTag<TQueryFnData, TTaggedQueryKey>,
  >(
    queryKey: TTaggedQueryKey,
    updater: Updater<
      NoInfer<TInferredQueryFnData> | undefined,
      NoInfer<TInferredQueryFnData> | undefined
    >,
    options?: SetDataOptions,
  ): NoInfer<TInferredQueryFnData> | undefined {
    const defaultedOptions = this.defaultQueryOptions<
      any,
      any,
      unknown,
      any,
      QueryKey
    >({ queryKey })

    const query = this.#queryCache.get<TInferredQueryFnData>(
      defaultedOptions.queryHash,
    )
    const prevData = query?.state.data
    const data = functionalUpdate(updater, prevData)

    if (data === undefined) {
      return undefined
    }

    return this.#queryCache
      .build(this, defaultedOptions)
      .setData(data, { ...options, manual: true })
  }
